site.name: SiteTwin new: 4.5G
notes: SiteTwin application: New monopole between homes and small apartment blocks

Synthetic sample for SiteTwin 3D, near Meta's Menlo Park campus. Antenna data and network KPIs are invented; the location is an ordinary city block. It is checked against Turkey's BTK limits like every site here: the US FCC limits are looser and not modelled.
Neighbouring buildings: 31 within 150 m from Microsoft building footprints; uses from OpenStreetMap (0 schools/health/childcare points).
Assumed, not in the SiteTwin file: antenna gain and beamwidths (typical values by band); antenna positions on the monopole (one side per sector); ground compound (8 x 8 m) around the monopole.
